other_parties: Hamilton Capital, LLC (investment adviser) | Ultimus Fund Solutions, LLC (transfer agent)
security_description: Shares of beneficial interest of Dynamic Alternatives Fund
event_status_details: The tender offer commenced January 16, 2026; the Fund offered to purchase Shares in an amount up to 5% of its net assets
offer_price: Net asset value per Share as of the Valuation Date, less any Repurchase Expenses
offer_price_basis: per share of beneficial interest of Dynamic Alternatives Fund
offer_price_qualifications: The Fund does not impose repurchase charges, but may allocate to tendering Shareholders their pro rata share of charges imposed by portfolio funds when interests are liquidated as a result of repurchase tenders | Partial repurchases are paid in cash; full repurchases are paid through a non-interest-bearing, non-transferable promissory note | The initial note payment is 95% of the estimated value of repurchased Shares; the final payment, if any, reflects the value determined using the annual audit | The Fund will not pay interest on the purchase amount
settlement_date: Acceptance: when the Fund gives written notice to the tendering Shareholder of its election to purchase the Shares | Partial-repurchase payment: generally within forty (40) calendar days after the Valuation Date, or, if the Fund has requested withdrawal of capital from Portfolio Funds to fund the purchase, within ten (10) business days after receipt of at least ninety-five percent (95%) of the aggregate amount withdrawn, whichever is later | Full-repurchase initial payment: within the later of forty (40) calendar days after the Valuation Date or ten (10) business days after receipt of at least ninety-five percent (95%) of the aggregate amount requested to be withdrawn from Portfolio Funds to fund the repurchase | Full-repurchase final payment: within 60 days of completion of the next annual audit, unless the stated circumstances cause a delay
proration_terms: If Shares in excess of 5% of the Fund’s net assets are duly tendered before the Notice Date and not withdrawn before the Expiration Date, the Fund may accept additional Shares permitted under Rule 13e-4(f)(3), extend and increase the Offer, or accept Shares for payment on a pro rata basis based on the aggregate net asset value of Shares tendered by each Shareholder
tendering_conditions: Shareholders must submit a completed and executed Letter of Transmittal, signed by all account owners and the custodian if applicable, so that it is received by 2/17/2026 11:59 PM Eastern time | Deliver by overnight mail to Dynamic Alternatives Fund, c/o Ultimus Fund Solutions, LLC, 225 Pictoria Dr, Suite 450, Cincinnati, OH 45246; by regular mail to Dynamic Alternatives Fund, c/o Ultimus Fund Solutions, LLC, PO Box 46707, Cincinnati, OH 45246; by fax to 402-963-9094; or by email to service@dynamicalternativesfund.com | Defects or irregularities must be cured within the time the Fund determines unless waived; the Fund may reject tenders not in appropriate form | The Fund may repurchase all remaining Shares if a partial tender leaves a holding below the applicable minimum initial investment
available_options: Shareholders may tender some or all of their Shares | A Shareholder may withdraw a tender before the withdrawal deadline and re-tender withdrawn Shares before the Notice Date
default_option: If a Shareholder does not wish to sell Shares, no action is required
financial_terms: The Fund offers to purchase Shares in an amount up to 5% of its net assets, calculated as of the Valuation Date, unless it elects to purchase a greater amount | Expected funding sources are cash on hand, including additional Share subscriptions; proceeds from sales of portfolio securities, including withdrawals of capital from Portfolio Funds; and possibly borrowings | The filing-fee table states a transaction valuation of $17354784 and a filing fee of $2396.70
conditions_restrictions: The Fund reserves the right to extend, amend, cancel, or postpone acceptance of the Offer | It may cancel, amend, or postpone acceptance if it cannot liquidate portfolio securities in an orderly manner consistent with its investment objectives and policies; the Board judges specified legal, banking, credit, trading, hostilities, net-asset-value, or other materially adverse circumstances to exist; or the Board determines that purchasing Shares is not in the Fund’s best interest | There are no material conditions to financing | The Offer is not made, and tenders will not be accepted, in jurisdictions where the Offer or its acceptance would not comply with applicable law

security_description: LGAM Private Credit LLC Common Units
event_status_details: The tender offer period began March 4, 2026.
offer_price: Net asset value per Common Unit as of March 31, 2026 or a later date determined by the Company if the Offer is extended
offer_price_basis: per Common Unit
offer_price_qualifications: Payable in cash | No charges imposed on repurchases | Payments may be subject to tax withholding
withdrawal_deadline: 4/1/2026 12:01 AM Eastern Time | If the Company has not accepted the tendered Units, withdrawal is permitted on or after 4/29/2026
settlement_date: Acceptance: when the Company gives written notice to the tendering Unitholder of its election to purchase | Payment: promptly after expiration, after net asset value per Unit as of the Valuation Date is finalized
proration_terms: If more than 554324 Units are duly tendered before expiration and not withdrawn, Units will be accepted for payment pro rata based on the number tendered | The Company may, in its sole discretion, purchase additional outstanding Units representing up to 2.0% of outstanding Units without amending or extending the Offer | No priority for death or disability | Unaccepted Units are not automatically carried forward or given priority in a future offer
tendering_conditions: All Unitholders are eligible | Complete and sign the Letter of Transmittal and email it to MSIM_IS@seic.com so the Company receives it by 4/1/2026 12:01 AM Eastern Time | For a partial repurchase, specify the number of Units, not a dollar amount | Each holder of a joint account must sign; entity requests should include evidence of signing authority | Defects or irregularities must be cured within the time the Company determines unless waived; tenders are not deemed made until cured or waived | The Company may reject tenders not in appropriate form or whose acceptance or payment would be unlawful
available_options: Tender all or a portion of Units | For a partial repurchase that would leave less than the required minimum account balance, elect to change the request to a full repurchase
default_option: If a requested partial repurchase would put the account balance below the required minimum, the Company may reduce the amount repurchased to maintain that balance unless the holder elects to change the request to a full repurchase
financial_terms: Up to 554324 Common Units, representing approximately 5.0% of Units outstanding as of December 31, 2025 | Potential funding sources are cash flow from operations, asset sales, borrowings, return of capital or proceeds from the continuous private offering | The Company has not determined to borrow funds but may do so in its sole discretion | The Company imposes no charges on repurchases
conditions_restrictions: The Company may extend the tender period and adjust the Valuation Date; if extended, net asset value will be determined as of the last day of the calendar month in which the tender period expires | The Company may cancel or amend the Offer or postpone acceptance before accepting tendered Units if repurchase would violate applicable law; specified litigation, banking, credit, market, hostilities, net asset value decline or other material adverse circumstances arise; or independent Directors determine purchase is not in the Company's best interest | The Company may waive Offer conditions or tender defects for particular Units or Unitholders | No material financing conditions are stated | The Offer excludes jurisdictions where making or accepting it would not comply with applicable securities laws

event_status_details: The Offer began on March 23, 2026.
offer_price: Net asset value per Share as of March 31, 2026 or a later date determined by the Company if the Offer is extended
offer_price_basis: per Class I common share
offer_price_qualifications: Shares issued after April 1, 2025 that are tendered and purchased are subject to a 2% early repurchase fee, reducing proceeds by 2% of their aggregate net asset value | Payment may be subject to tax withholding
withdrawal_deadline: 4/17/2026 11:59 PM Eastern Time | If Shares have not been accepted, withdrawal is also permitted on or after 5/18/2026

tendering_conditions: All Stockholders may tender | Deliver a properly completed and duly executed Letter of Transmittal, or an originally signed photocopy, and any other required documents to State Street Bank and Trust Company by mail, overnight delivery or fax before 4/17/2026 11:59 PM Eastern Time | Holders whose Shares are registered through a broker, dealer, commercial bank, trust company or other nominee must contact that institution to tender | Partial tenders must maintain a $20000 account balance based on Valuation Date net asset value, subject to the Company's stated adjustment rights | No alternative, conditional or contingent tenders will be accepted | The Company may reject improper or unlawful tenders and may waive defects or irregularities
available_options: Stockholders may tender all or a portion of their Shares | A holder requesting a partial repurchase may elect to change the request to a full repurchase if the partial amount would need to be reduced to maintain the minimum account balance
default_option: If no payment option is selected, proceeds will be transmitted according to the wire instructions on record with the Transfer Agent; proceeds for qualified, custodial and certain broker-controlled accounts will be issued to the custodian or broker dealer of record, as applicable

conditions_restrictions: The Offer may be extended, and the Valuation Date may be changed | The Company may cancel or amend the Offer or postpone acceptance before accepting tendered Shares, including if orderly portfolio liquidation is not possible, specified legal, banking, credit, market, war or other material adverse events occur, or directors who are not interested persons determine that purchasing Shares is not in the Company's best interest | The Company may waive Offer conditions or tender defects | The Offer excludes jurisdictions where making or accepting it would not comply with applicable law
